Start here. This call shows which companies have turned on your partner key, sorted by name. Send it with your partner key and no `KISS-Company` header; it is the only request that goes without one. Every company comes with a `company_id`. Put that in `KISS-Company` on each request you make for that company. You also get the locations you can reach, each with its `location_id`, your `external_location_code` and its address. If the company turned you on for only some locations, `location_scoped` is `true` and `locations` lists just those, which can mean none. The company's facility and lock-support phone numbers come back too, along with the name and email of each administrator. When a company turns you off, it drops out of the list. The [partner keys guide](/guides/partner-keys) walks through the whole flow.
